candidates.change_summary: Replace `withdraw(address(this).balance)` with `withdraw(0)` so that no ether is actually transferred.
Delete the `withdraw(address(this).balance)` statement, so the balance remains unchanged.
Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner)` check, allowing anyone to call `withdrawAll` and change the contract balance.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with `msg.sender.call{value: _value}("")` to change success/failure behavior and gas forwarding.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with `address(owner).call{value: _value}("")` so funds always go to stored owner, not caller.
Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner);` check from the modifier, allowing anyone to call functions using `onlyOwner`.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value - 1)` so one less wei is transferred.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with `revert()` so withdraw always fails.
